definition: The traditional Gaelic festival marking the beginning of winter, observed around 1 November; also, the season or month associated with it.
etymology: English borrowed it from Irish Samhain, the old name for the festival and for November. It is traditionally understood as “summer’s end,” from Old Irish elements for summer and ending.
usage: By Samhain, the garden had yielded its last bright remnants to the darkening year.
